name: Warm master
about: Rounds off the top, fills out the bottom and adds a little tape warmth to any song or voice.

name: Bright master
about: Lifts the top end and the presence so every word and cymbal sparkles, without getting thin.

name: Loud modern master
about: A punchy smile of an EQ, tape heat, extra width and a hard limiter, squeezed loud like a new pop single.

name: Gentle glue
about: A slow, soft compressor and a touch of width that pull a mix together without anyone noticing.

name: Clean and loud, no colour
about: Just louder: a flat EQ and a clean brick-wall limiter, nothing else changed.

name: Punchy drums master
about: A slow-attack compressor lets every hit snap through while the low thump and the crack come forward.

name: Late-night quiet listening
about: Rides the level and squeezes the loud parts down, with extra bass and treble so it stays full played softly.

name: Clear midrange master
about: Opens up the middle so voices, guitars and lead parts step forward and stand apart.

name: Big low end master
about: A deep, round bottom end with the tape head bump and a touch of width above it, for songs that need more weight.

name: Open and airy master
about: A silky high lift and a little extra width, like opening the windows on the mix.

name: Dense club master
about: Fat sub bass, fast compression, warm drive and a hard limiter for a dense, pounding dance master.

name: De-harsh the top
about: Takes the sting out of a harsh, shouty recording: softer upper mids and tamed hiss.

name: De-mud the low mids
about: Scoops out the woolly build-up around 250 hertz so a muddy mix comes clear.

name: De-boom the bass
about: Tames boomy, overblown bass and rumble so the low end stops swamping everything.

name: Warm up a thin recording
about: Adds body and chest to a thin, tinny recording and fills it in with saturation, keeping the top end open.

name: Brighten a dull recording
about: Brings back lost sparkle with a high lift and fresh harmonics from fast tape.

name: Clear out the boxiness
about: Cuts the hollow cardboard-box ring around 500 hertz that small rooms leave behind.

name: Cut the nasal honk
about: A narrow cut at the nasal honk near one kilohertz, for horns, voices and cheap mics.

name: Tame the cymbals
about: Rounds off splashy cymbals and spitty s sounds while the rest of the mix stays put.

name: Smile curve
about: The classic smiley EQ: big lows, big highs and a dip in the middle.

name: Wide stereo master
about: Spreads the mix wide across your ears while the bass stays solid in the middle.

name: Extra wide dream
about: A slow, lush chorus and huge width smear the sound right out past your ears.

name: Gentle widening, mono safe
about: Just a little extra width that still folds down cleanly on a single speaker.

name: Mono check on one speaker
about: Folds everything to one channel through a single cabinet speaker, to hear what mono does to the mix.

name: Slow stereo drift
about: The whole mix leans gently from one side to the other and back, slow as breathing.

name: Chorus-wide shimmer
about: A light stereo chorus that adds shimmer and spread, like a mix printed through a vintage rack unit.

name: Big room around the mix
about: A wide, soft room wraps around the whole mix, as if it plays in a big empty space.

name: Vintage vinyl master
about: Pressed to a record: soft top, quiet crackle and a gentle rumble under warm saturation.

name: Dusty jazz record
about: A well-loved old record: mellow and dark, with lots of dusty crackle and the odd pop.

name: Old 78 record
about: A shellac 78 played on an electric record player: narrow, hissy and crackling.

name: Song on a sun-warped record
about: A record left in the sun: the song sags and swells every turn over a low rumble and crackle.

name: Cassette mixtape
about: A home-made mixtape on an ordinary cassette: soft hiss, a little wobble and warm tape squash.

name: Mixtape played to death
about: A tape played a thousand times and chewed by the deck: dull, hissy, wobbling and dropping out.

name: Reel-to-reel warmth
about: Recorded hot on a studio tape machine running at full speed: thick, warm, gently squashed and slightly wavering.

name: Slow tape, hot and dark
about: Slow tape pushed hard: a big low bump, rounded highs and thick, sticky saturation.

name: Home video soundtrack
about: Music on an old home video tape at the long-play speed: hiss, hum and a wobbly, dull sound.

name: Eight-track cartridge
about: A car tape cartridge from the 1970s: boxy middle, soft top and a gently wandering pitch.

name: Music file from 1999
about: A song squeezed into a tiny early music file: swirly, watery highs and smeared drums.

name: Song on a wax cylinder
about: Your song squeezed into wax around 1900 and played through a horn, the hiss kept low so the tune comes through.

name: Lo-fi beat tape master
about: Warm, dusty and rolled off: an old sampler and a worn tape for laid-back beats.

name: Lo-fi study stream
about: Soft and sleepy: a dark filter, record crackle, a slow wobble and a hazy chorus.

name: Twelve-bit sampler crunch
about: The gritty, chunky sound of an old drum sampler with fewer bits and a lower sample rate.

name: Bedroom pop haze
about: Soft and dreamy: a warm chorus, rounded highs and the small room it was recorded in.

name: Slowed eighties mall fog
about: Slowed down, chorused and drowned in reverb, like a shopping centre tape from another decade.

name: Dusty sampled drum loop
about: Sampled off an old record and squashed hard: crunchy bits, fat lows and dusty crackle.

name: Sped-up soul sample
about: An old soul record sped up, thinned out and squashed, ready to loop under a beat.

name: Dub reggae tape
about: Deep warm bass, a rolled-off top and swirling dub echoes trailing after every phrase.

name: Taped off FM radio
about: A song recorded off the radio onto cassette: squeezed by the station, then a little hiss.

name: Band demo on a phone
about: Recorded on a phone across the room: thin, pumping and a bit swirly, like a rehearsal demo.

name: Slowed and reverbed
about: Slowed down and lower, with a big soft reverb, the dreamy late-night remix sound.

name: Slowed way down, deep
about: Even slower and deeper, sinking into a huge dark reverb.

name: A little faster and brighter
about: Sped up a touch, a little higher and brighter, with more bounce.

name: Sped-up high-energy remix
about: Much faster and higher, squashed loud and wide, the hyper dance-remix sound.

name: Song at half speed
about: The whole song at half speed: an octave down and twice as long, with a lift on top to keep some air.

name: Single played too slow
about: A 45 single played at 33: slow, low and lazy, with the record crackling along.

name: Slower, same key
about: Slows the whole thing down to practise along to, while every note stays in the same key.

name: Faster, same key
about: Speeds it up without the chipmunk sound: quicker, but every note stays put.

name: Song winds down at the end
about: Plays normally to the last moment, then the song drags down and grinds to a halt, like the power just went off.

name: Phone speaker check
about: How your mix sounds on a phone held at arm's length: no bass, all middle.

name: Laptop speakers
about: Through the little speakers in a laptop: thin, boxy and a bit hollow.

name: Cheap earbuds
about: Through the free earbuds that came in the box: tinny, harsh and no low end.

name: Little wireless speaker
about: A small portable speaker with a fake bass bump and a limiter pumping when it gets loud.

name: Kitchen radio
about: Playing on the little radio on the kitchen counter, bouncing off the tiles and cupboards.

name: AM radio song
about: A song coming in on the AM dial: narrow, warm and fizzing with static.

name: Telephone hold music
about: Your call is important: squashed flat and squeezed down a cell phone line.

name: Shop ceiling speakers
about: Background music from the speakers in the ceiling of a big store.

name: Car stereo
about: Played in the car with the windows up: booming bass and the close, soft sound of the cabin.

name: Car stereo on the highway
about: Cruising at highway speed with the music on: tyre roar and wind under the booming cabin.

name: Club sound system
about: A big club rig in a concrete warehouse: chest-thumping sub, bite and a hard bare room.

name: Stadium sound
about: Booming out of the towers of a stadium PA with the whole crowd around you.

name: Drive-in on the car radio
about: A drive-in movie's music coming through an old car radio, crickets singing outside the open window.

name: Party through the wall
about: The neighbours are having a party: only the thumping bass and a murmur get through.

name: Boombox on the street
about: A pushed portable stereo out on a city corner, bouncing off the buildings.

name: Background music in a cafe
about: Playing over the speakers of a busy coffee shop, under the chatter and the clinking cups.

name: Listening by a rainy window
about: Playing softly in your room while rain taps on the window beside you.

name: Live in a small club
about: Played live in a small club: a warm room, a little width and the walls close by.

name: Concert hall
about: Heard from a good seat in a concert hall, with the long warm bloom of the room.

name: Cathedral performance
about: Played in a stone cathedral, every note hanging in the air for seconds.

name: Raw basement band
about: A band bashing away in a tiled basement: overdriven, dark and close.

name: Arena rock live
about: Live from a huge arena: a big hall sound with the slap of the far walls coming back.

name: Stairwell session
about: Recorded in a concrete stairwell for its tall, ringing natural echo.

name: Plate reverb shine
about: A bright metal plate reverb glossing over the whole mix, the classic studio sheen.

name: Smoky jazz club
about: A dark, warm little theatre stage late at night, soft and close.

name: Eighties arena shine
about: Bright, chorused and wrapped in that big gated room sound of the 1980s.

name: Synth night drive
about: Glossy chorus, dotted echoes and a long shiny reverb for a neon midnight drive.

name: Chrome-bright hyper pop
about: Sharp, glassy and blown out on purpose: a sizzling top, clipped edges and no dynamics at all.

name: Fuzzy grunge mix
about: A layer of fuzz under the whole mix, scooped and dark, like a worn-out rock record.

name: Smooth soul satin
about: Silky, warm low mids, a gentle top and soft width, smooth as an old soul ballad.

name: Disco gloss
about: Tight, bright and bouncing, with a slow phaser swirling over the top like a mirror ball.

name: Dark ambient wash
about: Everything blurred, darkened and drowned in an endless cavern of reverb.

name: Crisp drum and bass shine
about: Tight sub, scooped low mids, crisp fast highs and a wide spread for fast breakbeats.

name: Cinematic lift
about: A deep low end, an enormous width and a shimmering reverb that rises like a film score.

name: Dreamy wall of sound
about: Chorused, softly overdriven and buried in a huge reverb until it becomes one warm wall.

name: Dance floor pump
about: The whole mix ducks and swells on every beat at 120, the pumping dance-floor sound.

name: Slow filter sweep
about: A resonant filter slowly opens and closes over the whole mix, like a DJ riding the knob.
